spec_evidence.checked: Cached twilio_messaging_v1 specs: MessageFlow appears as a required request property of the US A2P compliance endpoint from 1.40.0. The field is a free-text description of how end users opt in to receive messages, reviewed by carriers during campaign vetting.

fix.migration_guide: MessageFlow is now a required field on US A2P campaign registration. Its value is a human-authored compliance narrative describing the consumer opt-in flow, and carriers reject registrations with generic or fabricated text. No code migration can produce this value; the account owner must write an accurate description of their opt-in process. The mechanical part is limited to adding the parameter to the request once the business supplies the text.
fix.example_after:
form.set('BrandRegistrationSid', brandSid);
form.set('MessageFlow', process.env.TWILIO_A2P_MESSAGE_FLOW); // human-authored opt-in description, required by carriers
